ticket.summary: Steady drip from spout of original 1990s bathroom faucet, no pooling or leak under sink; scheduled cartridge replacement.
mitigation_advice: Optional overnight fix: close the faucet's shutoff valve under the sink (small oval handle on the supply line, clockwise until snug) to stop the drip [PB-01]

quote_lines.description: Faucet/shower cartridge replacement - bathroom sink faucet, original 1990s fixture

ticket.customer_message: Just clear out anything stored under the sink so the tech has room, and make sure someone 18+ is home. Nothing else needed - we bring the parts. Confirmed: Mon Sep 1, 10:30 AM at 16 Weaver Ct, faucet cartridge replacement $159 flat rate (tech will re-quote before any extra work if the valve body is bad). You're all set, Grace!
